desc: Parse N, arrays A and B; separate fixed values from `-1` counts.
If both arrays have no `-1`, check equality of all A[i]+B[i]; output Yes/No.
Else sort `fixedA` and `fixedB`; verify all pair sums `fixedA[i] + fixedB[i]` (for i < min(len(fixedA), len(fixedB))) are equal.
Print "Yes" or "No" based on the check.
Run mental tests on the three sample cases to confirm correctness.
Wrap the implementation in the standard `if __name__ == "__main__": solve()` guard.
